answer: Because the whisper forfeiture is applied at exit, the garden ledger totals each burn, and the hollow audit records the amount lost per key. An operator that moves capital between 252 aliases therefore destroys value on every move, which makes rotation strictly worse than leaving the bond in place. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
